name: Shipping - Tankers, Dry Bulk, Containers
edge: Low-glamour cyclical; direction is unusually legible from one headline.

catalysts.title: Suez / Panama / Red Sea disruption
catalysts.logic: Rerouting -> longer voyages -> higher rates -> bullish carriers.

secondOrder.note: Rerouting + higher energy/freight costs raise fertilizer input and delivery costs -> bullish producers.
Sustained oil-transport disruption lifts energy prices and energy-security bids -> supportive for nuclear fuel.

catalysts.title: Freight-rate spike
catalysts.logic: Rising rates flow directly to shipping-company earnings.

catalysts.title: OPEC output cut (crude tankers)
catalysts.logic: Less oil to move -> lower ton-mile demand -> bearish crude tankers.
